title: Dugway 'grey beard': 'we had the triangles out again last night'

tellings.quote: would say, "Oh, we had the triangles out again last night."

plain: At Dugway Proving Ground, a military test range in Utah, an old hand, a "grey beard", would remark casually, "Oh, we had the triangles out again last night," sometime between 2019 and 2022. The account comes from a guest who goes by the online name UAPGerb (UAP being the official term for unidentified flying objects), who tells Michels he heard this said directly. It is told because it would suggest triangle-shaped craft were being flown at the base often enough to be routine.
